info.title: Emergency Ambulance Dispatch System
info.description:
API collection aligned with current schema.

Roles: PATIENT | DISPATCHER | ADMIN

Seed logins (password: Password123!):
- admin@dispatch.com
- dispatcher1@dispatch.com
- patient1@dispatch.com

Flow: Auth → create request (PATIENT) → queue/assign (DISPATCHER) → status transitions → select hospital → complete → payment.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Public register always creates PATIENT. Promote roles via Admin → Change Role. Login test script saves tokens to collection variables.

tags.name: Ambulances
tags.description: Admin create/update/delete. Dispatcher can list + nearest.

tags.name: Requests
tags.description: PATIENT creates/cancels. DISPATCHER/ADMIN list + queue + assign.

tags.name: Dispatch
tags.description: Status machine: REQUESTED -> PRIORITY_ASSIGNED -> AMBULANCE_ASSIGNED -> DRIVER_ACCEPTED -> EN_ROUTE -> PATIENT_PICKED_UP -> TO_HOSPITAL -> ARRIVED -> COMPLETED. TO_HOSPITAL only via select-hospital.

post.description: Expect 400 Validation failed with field errors

delete.description: Sets deletedAt — row is not hard-deleted

get.description: REQUESTED/PRIORITY_ASSIGNED ordered CRITICAL→LOW, then oldest first

post.description: Expect 409 if ambulance/request already has active dispatch

patch.description: Fails if already ASSIGNED or beyond
Expect 400 if jumping e.g. AMBULANCE_ASSIGNED → COMPLETED
